Punjab University Student Elections Seen as Test for BJP-Akali Alliance

Student council elections at Punjab University are being framed as a potential indicator for the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) and Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) alliance ahead of the 2027 Punjab Assembly elections. The elections, involving 16,468 student voters, are contested between the All Sai Party (ASAP), National Students' Union of India (NSUI), and an alliance of Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) and Students' Organisation of India (SOI). Results are expected on the same day as the voting.
